title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation & Vector Databases: External Memory, HNSW & Chunking

visual.metaphor: Infinite obsidian library tower, 1536-D hypersphere vector coordinates with cosine angles, multi-floor HNSW skip-list elevator, recursive chunking guillotine with BM25 hybrid balance scale, cross-encoder cross-attention courtroom judge, and Self-RAG reflection token command cockpit

beats.description: Magi stands before a towering obsidian library; attempts to cram 50 thick encyclopedias into an LLM context funnel, triggering thermal alarms and quadratic attention choke; introduces external RAG memory
Magi operates a laser compression chamber, turning text into 1,536-dimensional coordinates; navigates a 3D Manim vector hypersphere with cosine angle theta between semantic neighbors
Magi on the observation deck of an HNSW multi-story graph; skips linear O(N) scans by taking long-range express hops on Layer 2 and diving to Layer 0 nearest neighbors in logarithmic time

Magi adjusts a golden guillotine for recursive sliding-window chunking; reveals dense vector blind spots with exact serial numbers, activating the Hybrid BM25 balance scale with Reciprocal Rank Fusion
Magi as a discerning courtroom judge examines 50 candidate passages; runs query and document through deep cross-attention layers, stamping out semantic impostors and elevating top 3 gems

Magi at a futuristic holographic cockpit operating dynamic Self-RAG reflection tokens: [Retrieve], [IsRel], [IsSup]; illuminates the entire library into a living, hallucination-free external neural mind
